title: Independent reading: Colossians 1:15–20
subtitle: Read a Christ-centered paragraph with repeated prepositional architecture.
overview: Colossians 1:15–20 uses repeated ἐν, διά, εἰς, and αὐτός to bind its claims. Make a preposition-and-reference map before paraphrasing the paragraph.
The goal is to observe structure: relative descriptions, explanatory γάρ clauses, and the final reconciliation purpose.

items.grc: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτίσθη τὰ πάντα ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
items.en: For in him all things were created, in the heavens and upon the earth.

items.grc: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν πρὸ πάντων καὶ τὰ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκεν.
items.en: And he is before all things, and all things hold together in him.
